tests.command: swift test && if [ -f project.yml ]; then xcodegen generate --quiet && xcodebuild -project Offgrid.xcodeproj -scheme Offgrid -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath .dd build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -quiet; fi
tests.description: Build the VictronKit package and run its tests (swift test), then generate the Xcode project and build the iOS app for the Simulator (xcodebuild). Both must pass. Tests use the local Mosquitto test broker and fixtures only, never the real Cerbo.

checklist: Swift string interpolation uses exactly one backslash: \(value). An escaped \\( renders as literal text on screen, and "\("%.0f W", x)" is not formatting; use String(format:).
No new LiveDataStore, HistoryStore, recorder or profile store is created where an existing one is passed in or owned by ConnectViewModel.
SwiftUI views live in App/Screens, never in Sources/VictronKit (the library also builds for macOS without UIKit).
Seeded random helpers (SplitMix64 and similar) use wrapping arithmetic (&*, &+) so they can't trap on overflow.
Tests that need a broker use TestBroker/FixtureReplayer on 127.0.0.1, wait for SUBACK/CONNACK instead of sleeping, fulfil every expectation, and stop the broker in tearDown; no nested queue.sync.
Nothing the app sends bypasses ReadOnlyPublisher (R/ topics only), and nothing contacts the real Cerbo.
